translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Luk
book.title: LUK Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Luk Tikak

content: Sakiyas Yerer Gak

Pen miñmon Jeriykow namb kun ak, bi maŋ nep won bap, maniy tap nuk kuŋay mindyiŋgip ak mindek. Yimb nuk ak Sakiyas. Nuk bi takes dep gok kuyip, maŋgiysek kond mindyiŋgip. Jiysis pandikakniŋ, biynimb kuŋaynep ap niŋniŋg geyak, Sakiyas bi maŋ won ak mey, Jiysis bi yerip rek ak niŋiyn aŋgiy,
nind amiy, mon bind bap tanaraniy, Jiysis apek tam bineŋ niŋmindek.
Jiysis pen ap, mon tan mindek kiñiŋ siŋak apiy, kuyoŋgiy niŋiy, Sakiyas nup aŋgak, “Kasek luŋg yowan! Miñiy korip nand ak, am mindeniŋgayn aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, Sakiyas luŋg yapiy, miñmiñ giyiŋg, Jiysis nup poŋind korip nuk amnak.
Biynimb gok gak kun ak niŋiy, miluk yapek aŋgyak, “Bi kun ak am, bi tap siy tap timey gip korip ak, kiniŋg amjap aŋgyak.”

Pen kisen am, Sakiyas korip ak minim aŋg mindyiŋg, Sakiyas Jiysis nup aŋgak, “Biyomb. Nand niŋan! Miñiy tap yand gok bilok pis ak ay, pis ak biynimb simbgeprek gok kuyip ñiniŋgayn. Yand nind tom giy, biynimb gunap tap kuyip siy dinik rek ayip gok, pen ñiniŋg, tap nokom bap dinik rek, pen omiŋal omiŋal ñiniŋgayn. Pen tap omiŋal siy dinik rek, pen ñiniŋg, onep jiy ak ñiniŋgayn. Kun giy, gi dam dam maŋgiysek day paŋg diy, kirginiŋgayn aŋgak.”

Pen biynimb gok niŋmindyakniŋ, Jiysis Sakiyas nup minim ak aŋgiy aŋgak, “Bi biy nusind Ebraham, Gor nup gosimb niŋak rek niŋimb ak mey; Gor miñiy nup diy, biynimb nuk yip korip jimñiy kinbay gok kuyip diy gip.
Yenen: bi bap Ñinuk wak ak, biynimb Gor ker mindpay gok kuyip diniŋg ma wak; biynimb nup ker ma mindpay gok kuyip diniŋg awak aŋgak.”
Bi Onep Wanjrem Ak Maniy Diyak

Pen biynimb kun gok, Jiysis mey, Biyomb per kond mindpun ak; Jerusalem amek, nup kiyŋ aŋgayon, chinup kond mindek, mindrep yimb giniŋgambun aŋgiy niŋyak. Jiysis gos niŋyak kun ak key niŋiy, minim nind aŋgak ak niŋyakniŋ, minim bap sek paydoŋ ay aŋgak,
“Bi biyomb mindep rek bap, kond mindep yand ak mindip amen, yip kiyŋ aŋgayek, andkind apiy, biynimb miñmon yand guniy kuyip kond mindenim aŋgiy, miñmon paryomb okok amniŋgamb.

Pen kisen amniŋgamb: nind bi nup woŋg giñiniŋgambay onep wanjrem ak kuyip suk aŋgek apey, maniy yir omiŋal, omiŋal keykey bilok ñiy aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Maniy ñispiyn biy diy, woŋg biysniys genimimb. Kisen yand tip ak winiŋgayn aŋgniŋgamb.’

“Kun aŋgiy, amniŋgamb ak pen; biynimb miñmon nuk yip jimñiy gok, nup miluk niŋiy, bi gunap aŋgyokey kisen amiy, bi kond mindep ak nup aŋgniŋgambay, ‘Bi chinup kiyŋ aŋg ayniŋg gispan biy, chin ma diniŋgambun aŋgniŋgambay.’
“Pen nup kiyŋ aŋgayek, tip ak andkind apiy, bi nup woŋg giñiniŋgambay gok kuyip, suk aŋgek apey aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Maniy ñinik gok sikyim gi andik mandik giy; pen yerip yerip dipim?’
Aŋgek, bi nind winiŋgamb ak aŋgniŋgamb, “Biyomb. Maniy yir yip ñinak omiŋal ak, sikyim gi andik mandik giy, pen yir ñin jiwiy ak dipiyn aŋgniŋgamb.”
“Aŋgek, biyomb ak aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Nand girep gipan. Tap sikoy ak ñenik, woŋg girep ginak rek, miñiy miñmon dawin yomb onep wanjrem ak aŋgen, kond mindeniŋgamban aŋgniŋgamb.’
“Bi namb ak apiy aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Biyomb. Maniy yir yip ñinak omiŋal ak, sikyim gi andik mandik giy, pen yir onep mamind ak dipiyn aŋgniŋgamb.’
“Aŋgek, biyomb ak aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Gipan kun ak rek, miñiy nip aŋgen, dawin yomb onep mamind ak kond mindeniŋgamban aŋgniŋgamb.’

“Pen bi nup woŋg giñemb bap apiy aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Biyomb. Yand nip niŋbiyn. Nand bi kalrimey yimb. Biynimb gunap tap kuyip gok sikyim girep giy mer; pilgiy rek dipan. Tap woŋg kosyam giy yimbay gok, nand kilis giy nep ñimban. Kun ak yand nip pirikiy mey, maniy yir yip ñinak omiŋal ak, yikop dam tiwniŋg ayen mindek, miñiy dand opiyn aŋgniŋgamb.’

“Aŋgek, biyomb ak aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Minim nak apan ak tuŋgandikiy, nip key kor giniŋgayn. Yip bi timey yimb, biynimb tap kuyip gok sikyim girep giy mer; yikop diy, tap woŋg kosyam gi yimbay gok, nand kilis giy nep, taw piliŋg dipan apan kun ak;
yenen maniy yip ak diy, dam beŋ ayey, andkind apiy siyniŋ gunap sek ma dipiyn aŋgniŋgamb.’
“Kun aŋgiy, bi yep maŋ siŋak mindeniŋgambay gok kuyip aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Maniy yir yip omiŋal ak piliŋg diy, bi maniy yir ñin jiwiy mindip ak nup ñim aŋgniŋgamb.’
“Aŋgek aŋgniŋgambay, ‘Biyomb. Nuk maniy yir ñin jiwiy ak, di mindip aŋgniŋgambay.’
“Aŋgey aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Nimbip aspiyn. Per biynimb tap kiyk kuŋay mindip gok, gunap sek dipay; pen biynimb tap kiyk siskoy mindip gok, gey pisnep yap amimb.
Pen biynimb, ‘Kiyŋ kun ak chin ma diniŋgambun aŋgiy, miluk niŋbay gok kuyip am dand apiy, windin yirik ar yip siŋbiy, ñaŋg aynimimb aŋgniŋgamb’ aŋgak.”
Jiysis Nup Kiyŋ Gok Kuyip Gipay Rek Giyiŋg Dand Jerusalem Amniyak
Jiysis kuyip minim kun ak aŋgiy, binuk gok yip Jerusalem amnun aŋgiy, nuk nind giy,
am am, Oliyp pir miñmon Betpasiy-Beteniy gol siŋak amjakiy, binuk omiŋal kuyip aŋgyokiy aŋgak,
“Miñmon wikan bindoŋ amiy niŋniŋgayr; doŋgiy marip biynimb ma dand tapay bap, tiwniŋgayey mindeniŋgamb. Wisikiy dand winimiyr.
Pen biynimb gunap apiy aŋgniŋgiy, ‘Kanj doŋgiy chinup ak yenen wisik dand amjipiyr aŋgeniŋgiy’ aŋgnimiyr, ‘Biyomb ak woŋg mindek aŋgyokamb, diniŋg opur aŋgnimiyr’ aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, amiy niŋrik: aŋgak rek nep mindek.
Am miñ ak wisik girikniŋ, bi doŋgiy nop nimb gok apiy aŋgyak, “Doŋgiy marip chinup ak yenen miñ wisiksipiyr?”
Aŋgey aŋgrik, “Biyomb ak woŋg mindamb aŋgip ak mey, wisiksipur aŋgrik.”
Kun aŋgiy, doŋgiy marip kun ak miñ wisikiy, poŋind dand Jiysis mindek ak amjakiy, chech kiyk band gunap tuŋgjiwiy, di doŋgiy ar ak ay, Jiysis nup di ar kun biyoŋ ayer bisgak.
Bisgiy, lor ar ak amnakniŋ, biynimb gok, chech tap okok dap lor ar kun ak ayakniŋ, tawyiŋg tawyiŋg amnak.

Am am, Jerusalem maŋ maŋ gakniŋ, Oliyp dum kinjeŋ kuyaŋgipay tip ak, biynimb nuk gok kuŋaynep, nup miñmiñ yimb giyiŋg, tap yerip yerip gak gok gos ak niŋiy, suk yomb aŋgyiŋg, Gor nup yimb ak dand aranyiŋg,
aŋgyak:

content.text: “Gor kiyŋ yomb chinup aŋgyokamb wip biy, chinup kond mindrep giniŋgamb.
Chinup direp yimb gip kun ak, yimb nup dand yiy ar biyoŋ aranjun aŋgyak.”

content: Kun aŋgyakniŋ, bi Peresiy gunap namb kun okok mindeyak gok, Jiysis nup aŋgyak, “Tiysa. Biynimb nak gok kuyip aŋg gey, kun ma aŋgyaŋ aŋgyak.”
Aŋgeyak, Jiysis aŋgak, “Nimbip aspiyn; kun ak ma aŋgeniŋgambay, Gor kamb gok gek, minim aŋgniŋgambay aŋgak.”
Jiysis Jerusalem Niŋiy Siy Aŋgak
Jiysis Jerusalem maŋ maŋ giyiŋg, dawin yomb kun ak niŋiy, siy ñiŋg tik dam yokyiŋg aŋgak,
“Miñmon Jerusalem. Nimbip simb yimb niŋsipiyn. Nimbip di Gor yip jimñiniŋg winik ak niŋbikip rek, tep yimb gipkip! Pen ma niŋiy, windin koy rek mindpim! Gor nimbip ker apek ma dipim rek,
kisen bi gunap ap dawin yomb nimbip biy, ñiluk ay kus kus gi mindiy,
pisnep gi timey yimb gey, woŋg wariy, minj, korip, tap gunap ma yimb mindeniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Jiysis Gor Aŋgniŋep Korip Miŋgan Ak Amnak
Kun aŋgiy, nuk Gor aŋgniŋep korip ak amiy, biynimb sikyim geyak gok kuyip, aŋg mis yokyiŋg aŋgak,
“Baybol buk tikiy aŋgyak, ‘Korip yand ak, yip aŋgniŋep korip ak mindip aŋgyak’ ak pen, nimb sikyim gem gem, biynimb tap siy diy, ap kapkap kinbay korip bap rek ayip aŋgak.”

Pen Jiysis minek minek, ap Gor aŋgniŋep korip miŋgan ak, biynimb gok kuyip minim aŋgñiyiŋgip. Bi Gor nup tap simboŋgep yomb gok, bi low tiysa gok, bi minim tuŋgasikep gok nup pikayun aŋgiy, gos nokom niŋyak ak pen,
biynimb maŋgiysek minim tep nup ak niŋun aŋgiy, yiñrimey yimb geyak, minim bap aŋgiy nup pikayniŋgiy rek ma ayak.
